scope: Explicit ordinary Codex exec/resume RuntimeProfile; native-final-text reuses existing Worker and Kernel final-output slot. Existing app-server profiles and sessions remain unchanged.
owner: AgentHost owns native evidence and per-Run settlement. Kernel retains Room, Inbox, cursors, Task, final marker, idempotency and authority.
implemented: Explicit adapter and registry/daemon composition, ordinary exec and exact-session resume, no app-server conversion.
Complete bounded stdout plus fresh last-message and exact rollout boundary/input/session/turn/model/effort/final-phase proof.
Session evidence independent from final success, missing bound rollout fails closed without replacement.
Selected single-target native text submitted with original Worker grant after evidence drain and before lease release.
Cancellation aborts post-exit settlement; recovery reports unknown without replay, durable marker remains authoritative.
Native per-response usage only; duplicate response capture times do not double count, conflicting usage becomes a gap.

limits: No default profile migration or existing-instance transport/session replacement.
SEA packaging, attached-directory resume, service-tier overrides and old app-server launch overrides are explicitly unsupported.
No native busy input; durable follow-up remains the owner.
With trial enabled, a Worker-only fallback interrupted by Host crash conservatively retains unknown settlement recovery.
Native sessions inventory and prefix hashing consume Host I/O/memory; 256 MiB rollout cap blocks continuation rather than rotating a session.
Compaction, long paid tasks, five-CLI matrix and multiplayer efficiency remain open.
